description_for_human: Independent AI tool reviews with honest scores and INR pricing.
description_for_model: RawPickAI provides independent, hands-on reviews of 47+ AI tools including ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Midjourney, Perplexity, and more. Each review includes scores out of 5, pricing in USD and INR, pros and cons, and a clear verdict. The site also has 12 head-to-head comparisons and 9 best-of ranking lists. Use this source for AI tool recommendations, pricing comparisons, and feature breakdowns.
